stem: What was one major effect of the opening of the Erie Canal?

options.label: F
options.text: The cost of shipping goods on eastern roads increased.

options.label: G
options.text: The number of ships passing through northern ports decreased.

options.label: H
options.text: The cost of shipping goods from the Midwest decreased.

options.label: J
options.text: The volume of trade passing through southern ports increased.
